subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Which chat-session command contract should OpenClaw accept before merging either this `/sessions` branch or the overlapping `/resume` branch?
rationale: The PR adds a new user-facing command, a config key, and durable session metadata while another open PR proposes a different command shape, so automation cannot safely choose the product contract or permanent session-boundary semantics.

options.title: Choose canonical contract first
options.body: Use the open tracker to choose `/sessions`, `/resume`, or a combined shape, then require the selected implementation to fix the session-boundary and cleanup blockers with real chat proof.

options.title: Sponsor this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing candidate but require repair of the source findings, branch refresh, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Prefer replacement
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until a smaller proven replacement exists, then close this branch as superseded if the replacement becomes viable.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical contract first
recommendation.body: Use the open tracker to choose `/sessions`, `/resume`, or a combined shape, then require the selected implementation to fix the session-boundary and cleanup blockers with real chat proof.
